html:
The Kitasoo/Xai'xais are a First Nation of the central coast of British Columbia, who live together at Klemtu on Swindle Island. The Kitasoo speak a southern Tsimshian dialect, while the Xai'xais speak a language close to that of the Heiltsuk.

The two groups came together at Klemtu in the late 1800s, when a cannery opened there. They fished, hunted seals and gathered along the outer coast, near the Gitxaała to the north and the Nuxalk inland. Their territory lies in the Great Bear Rainforest, home of the white Kermode or "spirit" bear, and they have taken part in protecting it.
